allocation_blocks.completion: All three independently complete6-app datasetblocks required pergraph; failed/partial attempts excluded and never appended; no blind retry.
allocation_blocks.order: Seeded arm permutation per dataset/horizon, cyclic block rotation; every arm occupies every position once. Horizon order short/long in blocks1/3, long/short inblock2. Dataset allocation orderF1,C1,F2,C2,F3,C3.
allocation_blocks.platform: Fresh rootplatform proof perallocation; exact sameGPU/CPUenvelope withinblock, placementmayvarybetweenblocks.
allocation_blocks.selection: one dataset and repetition_block per allocation; all6 fresh applications required
allocation_blocks.statistics: Pair arm ratios only within the same dataset/horizon/block; three complete block descriptive medians/ranges, no populationCI.

cache: Reusable native representation prepared once per dataset before all applications, full integrity scans may warm compact/native file pages. Fresh output/Numba cache per allocation block, shared within block including qualification. OS/PVC caches retained; no cold-I/O claim.

controller_guard_amendment.disk_limits: 4GiB live reserve and2GiB non-runtime cap on the actual admitted output backing filesystem; no reservation or node eviction-threshold guarantee
controller_guard_amendment.disk_observer: At actual approximately2s controller checks, bounded fsynced JSONL records statvfs bytes/inodes available and readonly flag on output backing filesystem;8MiB history cap; observer cost included without subtraction
controller_guard_amendment.hard_negatives: Controller deadline/environment/disk/output errors latch once, persist a bounded failure receipt when storage permits, and abort owned processes independently of transient PSS sampling errors; no throttle or successful sample clears them
controller_guard_amendment.output_observer: Non-atomic sampled output-byte cap, not instantaneous quota; one lstat per entry, vanished entries skipped and counted in bounded latest inventory receipt; observed bytes and known negatives never heal
controller_guard_amendment.scope: Fresh complete6-app datasetblocks; all3blocks pergraph, no failedpartial pooling

storage_admission.binding: Separate actual root proof JSON and whole SHA supplied by --platform-admission-json/--platform-admission-sha256, bound in each selected block plan and copied byte-exactly; no actual platform hash in this global protocol
storage_admission.preblock_minimum_bytes_available_rule: Pinned dataset native rowptr_bytes + col_bytes + sixGiB; caches already occupy storage and no old-data cleanup is assumed. Runtime fourGiB reserve remains.
storage_admission.scope: Actual Pod/host/boot/GPU/CPU pool/quota/memory/topology and root-bound PVC/image metadata fixed within each block. Source/graph/results/native/temp/cache use admitted project mount. Storage placement can affect timing; no reservation or continuous/exclusive health/bandwidth claim.

boundary_rescan.eligibility: Only ancillary task membership/observation churn with known unchanged own PID/start, exact leader mask, known exact cgroup and every observable hard predicate true; eventual fully stable PASS required within both caps
boundary_rescan.failure: Any observed resource/mask/PID/TID/cgroup negative fails immediately without another attempt; budget exhaustion fails; no repin or repair; all attempts retained, not just final PASS
boundary_rescan.wall_budget_scope: From before own identity read through terminal decision; a scan returning after deadline cannot PASS. OS I/O can overrun before failure is reported; not a hard real-time cancellation guarantee.

environment_policy.cohort: Three fresh6-app allocationblocks perdataset; six totalblocks. No pooling with historicalE25 orfailedattempts.
environment_policy.invariants: same host/boot/cgroup identity and memory limit; chosen CPUs remain in effective cpuset and online; externally observed process leaders and runtime threads have nonempty subset masks; own controller/app/worker boundary leaders retain exact chosen mask; any observed empty/outside mask or quota change aborts

leader_envelope_amendment.claims: Fixed27 CPU envelope plus exact owner boundary gates; not exact27 for every external descendant leader at every sample or continuous/exclusive placement
leader_envelope_amendment.cohort: Historical external-leader containment policy retained; current prospective cohort is three complete six-application blocks per dataset, no failed/partial or prior E25 pooling.
leader_envelope_amendment.motivation: Separate aborted ENVv4 cohort observed one new single-task descendant leader at[141]inside chosen27 during worker startup; all other observed masks/resources valid. Runtime startup is a plausible explanation, not a proven OpenMP mechanism or outside-envelope escape.
leader_envelope_amendment.no_healing: Every observed empty/outside task/leader mask remains an immediate hard negative even in unstable scans; no extra retry, repin, affinity mutation or science/supervision/order change
leader_envelope_amendment.scope: External descendant-tree observations admit nonempty leader subsets inside chosen27; all own boundary scans still require the exact27 leader mask and unchanged PID/start/cgroup

environment_policy.limits: shared27CPU time quota and27logical CPU mask are not exclusive physical cores, absence of contention, bandwidth reservation, or continuous observation
environment_policy.mutation: one controller affinity pin before admission; children inherit; app/worker guards never repin
environment_policy.observer: read-only named-predicate boundary guards plus complete before/after PID/TID/cgroup brackets in CPU/PSS observations approximately every2s; metadata work included, no subtraction; ambient pool changes outside chosen mask recorded
environment_policy.selection: highest27 currently allowed online logical CPU IDs, chosen once before admission/build/qualification; optional root-bound E25_EXPECTED_CPU_AFFINITY pins the same exact list for prelaunch qualification and controller

input_equality: typed/shaped ordered CPU PyG batch stream SHA and exact query indices for every consumed graph; short576 must equal long prefix576; hash time included without subtraction
long_semantic_prefix576: full input SHA snapshot only; no added CUDA sync or timing checkpoint
name: native_reuse_and_two_graph_lifetimes_v1
native: Exact same frozen NativeCSR persistent_touched_reset/pack_local in native-fresh and native-reuse; private mutable mapper per worker; no shared mapper
sampling: unchanged reference_union, original pair_seed and ordered S
scope: Two prospective public datasets and three execution/preparation boundaries under the original reference-union featureless DGCNN consumer; no quality/full-workflow/cold-cache/population inference
setup: Native-fresh promotes compactCSR once inside each app; native-reuse opens once-per-dataset immutable preconverted arrays, prepared and fully validated outside all app clocks. Both native arms allocate private8N mapper inside each spawnworker. Compiled natural JIT/cache loading unchanged.
timing: common checkpoint-synchronized E25; each short/long job genuinely terminates; interior synchronized prefixes are not independently terminated lifetimes or original E23 windows
